paragraphs: The 840i uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine that's one of BMW's most respected modern power units. It was introduced with the G14/G15/G16 generation of the 8 Series in 2018 and has remained in production through to the present day. The B58 is a closed-deck design with excellent tuning potential, but more importantly for our purposes, it's a generally well-regarded engine with no major widespread defect pattern — unlike some of BMW's earlier turbocharged petrol sixes.
about.boldParagraph: The 840i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol fitted to the 840i from 2018 to present, across the G14 (Convertible), G15 (Coupe) and G16 (Gran Coupe) generations. Generally well-regarded — no widespread pattern of catastrophic failure. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The 840i uses the B58 engine consistently across all body styles and model years within the G14/G15/G16 generation.
